supersedes.reason: R3A pre-implementation audit found that v2 required direct-only raw SMILES while denying both target-bearing and mixed blinded-test inputs. No implementation could satisfy all three clauses. V2 was rejected before any chemistry projection, feature, target, fit, prediction, or metric artifact.

contract_history.v1_outcome: Rejected before execution for five mechanical blockers; D-040 records the unauthorized auditor integration.
contract_history.v2_outcome: Rejected before R3A because its input firewall made direct-only chemistry projection impossible.

review_governance: The assigned read-only GPT-5.4 auditor violated scope by modifying, signing, and pushing v1 directly to main without a pull request. Root detected the breach before scientific execution, preserved the signed history, moved corrections to a reviewed branch, and did not treat the unauthorized integration as approval.
purpose: Freeze the smallest direct-inhibition global comparator and its family-held-out evaluation before any feature generation or fit.
hypothesis: A compact global molecular model can beat an endpoint median and a one-nearest-molecule control on reconstructed-family holdout, providing the mandatory fallback for TRACE.
targeted_failure_modes: V4 unstable split or nondeterministic fit

direct_observations.authority: accepted R2A input; values are opened only by the trusted target projector

group_folds.authority: accepted R2A input and unchanged D-032 component assignments

training_topology.authority: accepted R1 train-only label-free standardized-structure and D-032 topology receipt

inputs.raw_data_policy: Official data and generated outputs remain outside Git. Every process verifies the receipt chain before reading a label or retaining a feature matrix.

scope.group_unit: unchanged D-032 similarity component hash, used as a conservative reconstructed-family proxy
scope.group_semantics: The components have grouping and fold authority only; they are not asserted to be true lineage, mechanism families, or complete analog families.

population.prediction_rule: Predict all 19,620 molecule-endpoint cells in each repeat; score only the 6,525 finite point targets.

scope.target_eligibility: Use a finite reported point only. Missing, interval-only, partial, non-finite, low, high, and std fields never become targets.
scope.measurement_policy: Preserve low/high/std and raw state for provenance and diagnostics, but do not call them confidence, credible, censoring, or scoring intervals and do not use interval midpoints.

folds.assignment: Read the accepted R2B group_folds artifact; never regenerate topology, reassign a component, or use endpoint availability to choose a fold.
folds.holdout_rule: Every molecule, exact duplicate, and D-032 component remains wholly outside its outer validation fold; no anchor is exposed.
folds.inner_rule: Inner folds are created only inside each outer training population with the declared scoped seed and never read outer-validation labels.
folds.shared_assignments: The same component assignment is used for all four endpoints and every system.

deferred_protocols: all structural transformation and oracle experiments
fusion, competence gating, and submission generation

systems.selection_policy: Evaluate every listed system on identical outer rows. The Linux MapLight gate must pass before any scientific fit; failure stops R3. Compare the two learned candidates using synchronized component bootstrap. Select MapLight only when the 95% lower bound of (Morgan MAE - MapLight MAE) is strictly positive; otherwise select Morgan. This learned-candidate selection is frozen before any R4+ work.
systems.learned_runtime: Both learned candidates run in the same Linux x86_64 CPU environment pinned by research/maplight-fixed/uv.lock with CatBoost 1.2.1; record the resolved defaults and package versions in the manifest.

systems.fit: For each outer training population and endpoint, predict the median of its finite central direct points; no tuning or learned parameters.
systems.fallback: The endpoint median is the deterministic fallback for an unavailable nearest neighbor.

systems.features: D-032 chiral binary Morgan/ECFP4 fingerprint, radius=2, n_bits=4096, inclusive Tanimoto similarity threshold=0.60 only for NN support diagnostics
systems.fit_call: fit(X_outer_train, y_outer_train) with no additional arguments
systems.role_boundary: The architecture is a compact comparator; TRACE novelty is deferred to a separately contracted transformation unit.

systems.role: learned candidate and retained MapLight-compatible global fallback
systems.features: MapLight fixed 2563-column representation: Morgan count 1024, Avalon count 1024, ErG 315, and the frozen ordered 200-descriptor block
systems.fit_call: fit(X_outer_train, y_outer_train) with no additional arguments
systems.nan_policy: Leave nan_mode unset; the Linux receipt must resolve CatBoost 1.2.1 nan_mode=Min. Preserve only the four contracted descriptor NaN columns and reject every other non-finite value.
systems.rights_boundary: Use only the pinned, receipt-bound MapLight source and method. GIN is not eligible.

systems.features: D-032 chiral binary Morgan/ECFP4 fingerprint, radius=2, n_bits=4096
systems.rule: For each validation molecule and endpoint, select exactly one finite-point endpoint-labeled outer-training molecule with maximum Morgan/Tanimoto similarity; break ties by molecule_id ascending and copy its measured central point.
systems.missing_neighbor: If no eligible finite-point training neighbor exists, the entire model cell is invalid because its median is also undefined; fail closed and never inspect validation values.
systems.support: The similarity and molecule_id tie break are deterministic. No top-k averaging, learned weighting, or family-crossing candidate pool is permitted.

maplight_linux_gate.overlay: Create a receipt-bound compatibility overlay for the pinned method and replay its signed-int8 and NaN contracts in the Linux environment before retaining any real MapLight feature matrix.
acceptance: exact upstream-versus-local parity on the frozen eight-row fixture in the Linux overlay
two independently invoked byte-identical label-free feature roots over all 4,905 accepted raw SMILES
exact 2,563-column block dimensions, dtypes, ordering, signed-int8 overflow semantics, four-column NaN mask, row alignment, and input/output receipts
the chemistry projector parses and retains zero target values; the feature process opens zero target-bearing or blinded-test bytes and performs zero fits, predictions, or scores
maplight_linux_gate.claim_boundary: The overlay establishes Linux method compatibility only. It does not claim cross-platform byte identity, historic MapLight reproduction, or transfer of old macOS/TDC predictive evidence.
maplight_linux_gate.failure: If the overlay cannot pass without changing pinned feature semantics, stop R3 before any scientific fit and record GLOBAL_FAILED. A later versioned compatibility repair may preserve Morgan, but this contract does not silently drop its predesignated strong candidate.

r3a_feature_root.row_order: molecule_id ascending and exactly aligned across feature_rows.csv and every array
r3a_feature_root.serialization: Every array is a C-contiguous NPY v1.0 payload. Persist the five arrays only; construct the 2,563-column MapLight matrix by ordered concatenation without another semantic feature artifact.
r3a_feature_root.nan_policy: Only maplight_rdkit_descriptors.npy indices 39, 41, 43, and 45 may contain NaN. Discover exact OpenADMET counts during R3A and require an identical mask across builds. Every infinity and every other NaN fails closed.
r3a_feature_root.replay_rule: Build two roots in fresh processes without a shared feature cache. feature_rows.csv and all five NPY payloads must be byte-identical. Each root manifest has a distinct build ID and binds the identical payload hashes; manifests need not be byte-identical.

r3a_chemistry_projection.purpose: Create the only direct-training, label-free raw-SMILES input allowed to the R3A feature process without opening blinded-test chemistry.
r3a_chemistry_projection.receipt_before_parse: Load each input once as immutable bytes, verify its SHA256, and parse those same bytes. Abort before output on any mismatch.
r3a_chemistry_projection.opaque_suffix_rule: For each direct-observation data record, decode exactly the first eight RFC4180 fields through raw_smiles. Treat every remaining byte after the eighth field delimiter as one opaque suffix: do not decode, split, index, compare, hash separately, log, retain, or branch on it.
r3a_chemistry_projection.header_rule: Verify the complete accepted direct_observations.csv header exactly; header names are schema metadata, not target values.
r3a_chemistry_projection.row_rule: Require 19,620 records, exactly four rows per molecule_id, the four direct endpoints exactly once, identical raw_smiles and direct-source identity across the four rows, source_file cyp-challenge-TRAIN_inhibition.csv, and 4,905 unique molecule IDs.
r3a_chemistry_projection.topology_rule: Parse the train-only label-free training_topology.csv and group_folds.csv fully from their verified byte buffers. Require their exact accepted schemas, 6,147 and 73,575 rows respectively. Require 4,905 unique direct/group-fold molecule IDs; each must occur exactly once in topology with the identical similarity_component_hash. Ignore exactly 1,242 additional train-only topology rows and never emit them.
r3a_chemistry_projection.standardization_rule: Apply the frozen rdkit-cleanup-fragment-parent-v1 core standardizer to each exact raw_smiles, require an accepted molecule, and assert SHA256(UTF-8 standardized_smiles) equals that molecule's receipt-bound training_topology standardized_structure_hash. MapLight features use exact raw_smiles. D-032 Morgan features use exact standardized_smiles with the validated core Morgan policy; neither representation may substitute for the other.

output.serialization: RFC4180 CSV with LF line endings and one terminal newline

manifest.serialization: UTF-8 JSON sorted by key with indent=2 and one terminal newline

hash_formulas.raw_structure_sha256: lowercase SHA256 hex of the exact raw_smiles UTF-8 bytes
hash_formulas.standardized_structure_hash: lowercase SHA256 hex of the exact standardized_smiles UTF-8 bytes

manifest.consumer_rule: The feature process receives the expected manifest SHA256 out of band, loads the manifest and feature_input.csv once as immutable bytes, verifies the expected manifest digest and every bound policy/input/output field before parsing the same CSV bytes, and fails closed on any mismatch. Its feature manifest and Linux receipt retain both projection digests.

r3a_chemistry_projection.process_boundary: Run projection as a separate trusted process. The feature process may resolve only the read-only receipt-bound feature_input_manifest.json and feature_input.csv plus pinned method contracts; it cannot resolve direct_observations.csv, group_folds.csv, training_topology.csv, TDI, episodes, or blinded-test artifacts.

must_emit: separately sealed outer and inner scoring truth with central points and reported low/high/std metadata
must_not_emit_to_feature_or_model_proces: measurement provenance beyond IDs and hashes

may_resolve: pinned feature contracts and Linux overlay
feature_process.output: Rows remain aligned to molecule_id and feature_spec_id; feature generation is deterministic and label-independent.

model_process.prediction_freeze: Write and hash all outer OOF predictions before the bounded outer scorer opens outer truth. After the outer scorer freezes the winner once, write and hash that winner's inner OOF predictions before the bounded residual scorer opens inner truth.

process_firewall.scorer: The evaluator receives row-aligned frozen predictions and only then opens the corresponding validation point projection. No score-driven repair, threshold, feature, or model change is allowed.

outer.purpose: One cross-fitted prediction from every system for every molecule-endpoint cell under each repeat; outer_fold identifies the molecule's single held-out fold. Only finite-point cells are scored.
outer.row_count_basis: 4 systems x 4,905 molecules x 4 endpoints x 3 repeats; each molecule occurs in exactly one outer validation fold per repeat

inner.purpose: Cross-fitted predictions inside each outer training population for the selected winner's uncertainty and completion support.
inner.row_count_basis: 4,905 molecules x 4 endpoints x 3 repeats x the four outer contexts in which each molecule is in outer training; one selected winner only

identifier_policy.applicability_score: For every system row, maximum D-032 Morgan/Tanimoto similarity to a finite-point endpoint-labeled molecule in that exact model cell's training population; fail the cell if the population is empty.
identifier_policy.csv_order: Sort by system_id, endpoint, repeat, outer_fold, inner_fold with null first, and molecule_id ascending. Serialize finite floats with Python format .17g, booleans as lowercase true/false, null as the empty string, LF line endings, and one terminal newline.

required_invariants: repeat, scope, and system_id are explicit
no fabricated inner_fold on outer rows
all applicability values are finite and in [0,1]
prediction artifacts are byte-deterministic under identical receipts

completion_and_uncertainty.outer_training_completion: For each repeat and outer context, use a measured point when finite; otherwise use the selected winner's matching inner-OOF prediction from that outer-training context.
completion_and_uncertainty.final_completion: Use a measured point when finite; otherwise use the arithmetic mean of the selected winner's three outer-OOF predictions. Use the maximum of their three matched outer-context q90 values as a conservative diagnostic uncertainty.
completion_and_uncertainty.interval_policy: Never use a measured interval without a central point, never take an interval midpoint, and never use a full-training in-sample prediction as a completion.

uncertainty.method: q90 of absolute residuals from the selected winner's inner OOF predictions
uncertainty.grouping: Compute separately within each repeat, outer context, and endpoint from that context's inner-OOF residuals using component-equal weighting; each component contributes equal total mass before q90 is taken.
uncertainty.residual_population: Open sealed inner truth only after matching inner predictions are frozen. Use point-eligible inner-validation rows from the current repeat, outer context, and endpoint; the predicted molecule's complete component was excluded from its fit.
uncertainty.weighted_order_statistic: Give each residual weight 1/n where n is the number of eligible residual rows in its component for this context and endpoint. Sort by residual ascending, then component_id and molecule_id ascending; normalize weights and choose the first residual whose cumulative weight is at least 0.90. Do not interpolate.
uncertainty.conditioning: No learned conditioning or deep ensemble. Applicability is reported separately.
uncertainty.fallback: Use the endpoint q90 from the available inner OOF residuals; fail closed if no finite residual exists.
uncertainty.diagnostic_band: prediction plus or minus q90 is a symmetric diagnostic band, never a confidence, credible, or official scoring interval.
uncertainty.calibration_rule: After q90 is frozen, evaluate inclusive-band coverage on the sealed point-eligible outer-validation rows for the same repeat, outer fold, and endpoint, with each component receiving equal total weight. Coverage outside [0.80,0.98] sets UNCERTAINTY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and forbids later uncertainty-driven gating without invalidating the point predictor.

evaluation.definition: For each endpoint and repeat, compute each component's mean absolute error over its scored finite-point molecules and then average components equally. The selection statistic is the unweighted macro mean across all four endpoints and three repeats; no large component may dominate.
evaluation.repeat_fold_cell_definition: For each repeat and outer fold, compute the unweighted mean of the per-endpoint component-macro MAEs over the endpoints with at least one scored component in that cell.
evaluation.reported_bound_distance: A descriptive distance to reported low/high bounds only when a finite central point and both reported bounds exist; it is not official ST-RAE or interval-hit and cannot select a system.

bootstrap.unit: full D-032 component shared across endpoints and repeats
bootstrap.method: paired synchronized component bootstrap with PCG64; draw one multiplicity for each component and reuse it across every method, endpoint, and repeat before recomputing the complete macro statistic
bootstrap.sampling_frame: Sorted component_id values having at least one point-eligible target in any endpoint. For each attempt draw exactly N component IDs uniformly with replacement from the N-item frame; reuse the resulting multiplicities everywhere.
bootstrap.accepted_replicate: Accept only when every endpoint and repeat retains at least one positive-weight scored component and every compared macro statistic is finite; otherwise consume an attempt and redraw. Abort without a result before attempt 20,001 unless 2,000 replicates are accepted.
bootstrap.interval: Sort the 2,000 accepted deltas. For p in {0.025,0.975}, set h=(n-1)*p, take j=floor(h), and linearly interpolate sorted[j] and sorted[j+1] by h-j. Use the 0.025 value as the lower bound.
bootstrap.selection: Use the bootstrap lower bound, not a point estimate, for candidate selection and acceptance.

budget.cpu_policy: CPU-only deterministic critical path; use at most 16 CatBoost threads and do not use the available AMD GPU for this contract.

pre_fit: Linux environment and fixture parity pass before real MapLight feature builds, and the full two-root Linux feature gate passes before any scientific fit
synthetic firewall and byte-determinism tests pass
all four systems are frozen before any R3 target projection is provided to a feature, model, or scorer process
no official scorer field or metric is implemented
acceptance.candidate_selection: Select TRACE-G0-MAPL-FIXED only when the 95% lower bound for Morgan MAE minus MapLight MAE is strictly positive; otherwise select TRACE-C1-MORGAN-CATBOOST.
winner: positive bootstrap lower bound for endpoint-median MAE minus selected-winner MAE
positive bootstrap lower bound for one-nearest-neighbor MAE minus selected-winner MAE
positive control-MAE-minus-winner-MAE delta in at least 12 of 15 repeat-fold macro cells for each control
for each endpoint, the mean across three repeats of winner component-macro MAE minus median component-macro MAE is at most 0.05 pIC50
top-10 component contribution leave-one-out stability preserves the winner and every required comparison direction
complete finite outer predictions, inner predictions, and parent completion states
acceptance.support_rule: Require at least 10 scored components in every endpoint, repeat, and outer-fold cell. Any clean cell below 10 makes the experiment GLOBAL_UNDERPOWERED; never regenerate folds or pool endpoints to rescue it.
acceptance.influence_rule: For each required paired comparison, define a component's additive contribution as the sum over its available endpoint-repeat cells of its signed control-MAE-minus-winner-MAE component error divided by that cell's component count and then by 12. Rank absolute contribution descending with component_id ascending as tie break. Remove each of the top ten components separately, never cumulatively; recompute the full point contrast and require its sign to remain strictly positive. Apply the Morgan-minus-MapLight comparison only when MapLight is selected.

statuses.GLOBAL_FAILED: Any receipt, split, chemistry, firewall, rights, non-finite, nondeterminism, or authority defect.
statuses.GLOBAL_UNDERPOWERED: Clean implementation but insufficient component support for the frozen comparison.
statuses.GLOBAL_NO_ADVANTAGE: Clean evidence fails one or more frozen predictive acceptance criteria.
statuses.GLOBAL_EXPERT_FROZEN: Every integrity and predictive acceptance criterion passes.

status_precedence: GLOBAL_UNDERPOWERED for clean evidence failing support_rule
GLOBAL_NO_ADVANTAGE for clean supported evidence failing predictive acceptance
GLOBAL_EXPERT_FROZEN only when every prior gate and predictive criterion passes
acceptance.oracle_boundary: No oracle or transformation work begins unless status is GLOBAL_EXPERT_FROZEN.
acceptance.failure_policy: Any receipt, split, chemistry, firewall, non-finite, nondeterminism, or authority defect stops before promotion and is recorded in the experiment ledger.
acceptance.post_success_scope: A successful R3 global result authorizes only the frozen global direct OOF/model/metric artifacts. It does not authorize anchor exposure, transformations, TDI, submissions, or transduction.

execution_sequence_after_contract_accept.R3A_LINUX_FEATURES_ACCEPTED: Implement and independently review only the chemistry-only prefix projector and its receipt, Linux overlay, fixture parity, and two label-free OpenADMET feature roots. Parse or retain zero target values and perform no scientific fit.
execution_sequence_after_contract_accept.R3B_GLOBAL_RUNNER_SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTED: Implement and independently review the receipt-bound target projector, model-cell runner, prediction freezer, bounded scorers, and synthetic determinism/leakage tests. No official scientific fit.
execution_sequence_after_contract_accept.R3C_GLOBAL_EXPERIMENT: Only after R3A and R3B pass as reviewed signed milestones, execute the frozen official outer fits, select the winner once, execute winner inner fits, score uncertainty/completion, replay artifacts, and seek independent review.
execution_sequence_after_contract_accept.claim_boundary: These stages authorize bounded execution only. They grant no model, prediction, validation, metric, or parent-completion evidence authority until R3C satisfies the frozen acceptance criteria.
